messages:
maya: Quick sync—Shoreline sprint slice decision. Two competing asks: 1) customer hotpath embed regression (blocks paid customers) 2) UX polish on modal flow for engagement metric. Need to pick the immediate next mini-sprint focus. Thoughts?

sam: +1 to hotpath. revenue impact + email from Acme yesterday.

lina: Hotpath sounds urgent. QA estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day regression matrix.

jon: Agree hotpath. Can we scope it to a single deployable patch rather than refactor?

maya: Good Q — preference is a targeted patch with tests. If we go hotpath, we drop the UX polish from this wave and schedule it in Wave B.

anita: Data note: the modal polish lifts CTR ~3% but only for new-user cohort. Hotpath impacts all customers and spikes errors.

sam: Proposed plan: "hotpath quickfix" task list: 1) reproduce root cause 2) add defensive validation 3) add unit + integration tests 4) canary rollout. I can own steps 1-3.

lina: ETA for tests depends on test infra flakiness. I can pair with Sam for the integration test tomorrow.

maya: Decision check: prioritize hotpath in next 3-day mini-sprint. UX polish moved to post-mini backlog with soft-commit for next week. Anyone object?

jon: No objections. Will prep the customer comms note after patch is in canary.

anita: I'll update the dashboard alert and set a regression watch on embed latency for the release window.

sam: I'll open the PR today with `WIP: hotpath quickfix` and add reviewers @lina @jon.

lina: ack, will review.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for commit abc123 on cluster shore-1.

maya: Action items: Sam -> PR + tests; Lina -> test signoff; Jon -> customer comms; Anita -> dashboard + SLI watch. I'll update the roadmap board and ping stakeholders. Thanks all :thumbsup:
